title: Marlowe Rewards Tier Perks on Shipping, Price Adjustments and Returns
content:
Each Marlowe Rewards tier carries shopping perks that apply to the member's Online Orders and to their Returns & Exchanges. The table gives every perk at every tier.

| Perk | Member | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Icon | Atelier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Order merchandise subtotal, after discounts, at or above which Standard Ground ships free (USD; 0.00 means always free) | 89.00 | 69.00 | 49.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Expedited 2-Day charged at the Standard Ground fee | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Calendar days after the order's placed date during which a price adjustment may be requested | 14 | 14 | 14 | 21 | 30 | 30 |
| Calendar days added to the standard return window | 0 | 0 | 15 | 30 | 30 | 60 |
| Restocking fees waived | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Prepaid mail-return label fee waived | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

The column headings are the Marlowe Rewards tiers: Marlowe Rewards Member, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Icon and Atelier.

## Illustrations (hypothetical orders)

- An order with a merchandise subtotal after discounts of 69.00 USD ships Standard Ground free for a Marlowe Rewards Silver member. The same order for a Marlowe Rewards Member, whose threshold is 89.00, does not.
- For Platinum, Icon and Atelier members the free Standard Ground threshold is 0.00, so Standard Ground is always free.
- A Marlowe Rewards Gold member's return window is the standard window plus 15 calendar days.
